source_functions.FUN_0019eb90: reads current gameflow livery label from static string table VA 0x23acb0, resolves that string in the car resource selector-name list through FUN_00125640, validates returned selector against the model variants through FUN_00125700, stores the typed selector via FUN_00121e10, and calls FUN_00123f18 to remap descriptors from entity+0x64.

resource_selector_list_abi.id_semantics: FUN_00125640 returns the matching resource-list ordinal in the typed identifier low 16 bits; FUN_00125700 requires an ordinal represented by the model variant group.
